subject.title: fix(custodian): show mode-appropriate guidance and defaults

question: Does the maintainer approve the user-facing caretaker copy and confirmation recommendation behavior after direct after-fix proof is attached?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes user-visible guidance and recommendation framing, and the protected `maintainer` label requires a human merge decision rather than automatic handling.

options.title: Approve after direct proof
options.body: Attach a redacted screenshot, recording, or live-output transcript covering normal mode, onboarding mode, and an explicit false confirmation default, then merge if the intended wording and emphasis are confirmed.

options.title: Adjust the presentation contract
options.body: Request a narrower copy or recommendation policy before merge if the current wording or visual recommendation is not the desired product behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve after direct proof
recommendation.body: Attach a redacted screenshot, recording, or live-output transcript covering normal mode, onboarding mode, and an explicit false confirmation default, then merge if the intended wording and emphasis are confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the focused implementation and can supply the missing behavior evidence or clarify the intended presentation decision.
